description: This file contains unit tests for in-memory backend storage and session management components within an agent package. It tests setting, getting, deleting, listing keys, scope isolation, type safety, and fallback mechanisms, as well as integration with an agent that uses this memory backend.

methods.name: TestInMemoryBackend
methods.description: Unit tests for in-memory backend including set, get, delete, list, scope isolation, type safety, and data clearing.

methods.name: TestMemory_DefaultScope
methods.description: Tests for default session memory scope including set, get, delete, list, and defaults.

methods.name: TestMemory_WorkflowScope
methods.description: Tests for workflow-specific memory scope, verifying isolation and sharing within a workflow.

methods.name: TestMemory_GlobalScope
methods.description: Tests for global scope, ensuring data is shared across sessions and isolated from session-specific data.

methods.name: TestMemory_UserScope
methods.description: Tests for user-specific scope across sessions.

methods.name: TestMemory_ScopedGetTyped
methods.description: Tests for retrieving typed data from the memory scopes, including structs, slices, and non-existent keys.

methods.name: TestMemory_FallbackToRunID
methods.description: Tests to verify fallback behavior when session or workflow scope lacks specific context and defaults to run ID.

methods.name: TestMemory_NilBackend
methods.description: Tests that creating a memory with a nil backend defaults to internal in-memory backend and functions correctly.

methods.name: TestAgentMemory
methods.description: Tests that an agent instance correctly initializes with a memory backend and handles setting/getting data.

methods.name: TestAgentWithCustomMemoryBackend
methods.description: Tests that an agent can be configured with a custom memory backend and functions properly.
